test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.

Many state governments __are facing a__ financial crunch.
solution:
The correct answer is **No improvement required.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the** present continuous tense.**
 
• Thus the above sentence is correct, there is No improvement required.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The sentence structure for the present continuous form would be-
 
 
• **S + is/are+ verb+ ing +O**
 
• Examples- **Many Indians are facing unemployment nowadays.**
